headline: South Africa's Nedbank Acquires 66% Stake in Kenya's NCBA Group
summary: Nedbank finalized its acquisition of a 66% controlling stake in NCBA Group, making Kenya's fourth-largest bank a subsidiary of the South African lender.
why: Nedbank is one of South Africa's largest commercial banks, and regional acquisitions help expand its footprint across growing East African economies.

impacts.name: Nedbank Group
impacts.why: Securing majority ownership in a top Kenyan lender expands Nedbank's cross-border banking operations.
